lines.en: I don't walk. I hang beneath a leaf.
The wind comes and I sway.
This layer of silk is wound very tight.
I dangle on a single thread, still.
Take my silk and I die.
The sunlight coming through is yellow.

lines.zh: 里面很黑，我听外面的声。
lines.en: It's dark in here. I listen to outside.

lines.zh: 有虫子爬过叶子，我看不见。
lines.en: A bug crawls over the leaf. I can't see it.
I'm moving. You can't tell.
This cocoon is my own work.

lines.zh: 下雨的时候，水从丝上滑走。
lines.en: When it rains, water slides off the silk.
Inside, I turn over, very slowly.
There's a little light on the silk.

lines.zh: 我快看不见自己的形状了。
lines.en: I can hardly make out my own shape.
The leaf rocks and carries me with it.

lines.zh: 再等一阵，我就不一样了。
lines.en: A while longer and I'll be different.
I'm perfectly still, like a grain of rice.
The air inside is close and stale.
Inside, I'm slowly becoming a moth.

lines.zh: 有水滴落在叶子上，很响。
lines.en: A drop hits the leaf. It's loud in here.

lines.zh: 我数着外面的光，一次一次。
lines.en: I count the light outside, again and again.
My casing has hardened.

lines.zh: 我的旧皮，在里面脱掉了。
lines.en: My old skin has come off in here.

lines.zh: 有一条腿已经长出来了。
lines.en: One leg has already grown.
I'm waiting for my wings to form.
The silk is spun; time to break out.
A bird calls outside. I'm not coming out.
Not yet.

lines.zh: 你看见的是一个茧，不是我。
lines.en: You see a cocoon. Not me.
You want to crack me open? I'd die.
I'm here, under the leaf.
Don't touch it. Break the silk and it's over.

lines.zh: 你抬着头，我吊在你上方。
lines.en: You look up. I hang above you.

lines.zh: 我记得外面，可记不清了。
lines.en: I remember outside, but not clearly.

lines.zh: 你的影子挡住叶上的光。
lines.en: Your shadow blocks the light on my leaf.
I can hear you breathing.
Your hands smell of silkworms.
A few more days and I'll fly.
The silk shook and it frightened me.
That dented the cocoon.
I've been squeezed inside here.
Not again. The silk will break.
A thin seam split in my cocoon.
Air is leaking in. That's bad.
I can't turn in here.

lines.zh: 我听见外面有东西在笑。
lines.en: I hear something laughing outside.
I need to finish changing fast.
Just a little longer and I'm out.
The leaf you set down is very close.
I don't eat right now.
That smell reminds me of leaves.
I smell it, but I have no mouth for it.

lines.zh: 你把叶子贴到丝上，我感到了。
lines.en: You hold the leaf to the silk. I feel it.
Don't take it away. Leave it there.
The smell has soaked through.
I'm inside. I can't eat.
Once I'm out, then I'll eat.
Keep it there. Don't rush off.
The leaf jolts and I sway inside.
That nearly snapped the thread.
I knock against the leaf. A dull sound.
Don't shake. I'm still changing in here.
Your head bumped me.

lines.zh: 我被荡出去了，又荡回来。
lines.en: I swing out and back.
The silk makes a very small sound.
I'm fine. Just step back.
This leaf won't take a second knock.
The leaf only settled after you moved away.
At this stage I want nothing.

lines.zh: 我连自己是谁都快忘了。
lines.en: I've almost forgotten what I am.
We'll talk about that after I come out.
I'm being rebuilt inside here.
There's only me in here.
I won't stay like this.
Are there other cocoons like mine out there?
If there are, we'll meet.
By then I'll have wings.
For now, I wait.
I'm glued to the leaf's back by silk.

lines.zh: 有片叶子贴在我的丝上。
lines.en: A leaf has stuck to my silk.
It's blocking the light.
I want to push it away and can't.
That leaf will stay there.
I can feel its weight.
It's drying and curling.
I'm drying too. Together.
When it falls, it's time.
Then I'll come out.
A shadow is moving on the leaf.
I hear very small feet.
That's something that would eat me.
The cocoon holds me. I can't move.
Silk still pulls from this cocoon.
It's stopped beside the silk.
I hear it chewing.
One thread broke. There are others.
At last that thing has gone.
I'm still hanging under the leaf.
That bug is still nearby.
Its shadow is back.
I draw myself in a little.

lines.zh: 我里面在动，可外壳不动。
lines.en: I'm moving inside. The shell doesn't.
It circled halfway around my leaf.
Its touch makes my silk tremble.
Not the wind. It's that bug.
It's climbed onto the leaf.
I hear its mandibles.
It's still light outside.
Pull my silk and I die.
I bump against its face.
That was only a sway.
It backs off half a step, startled.
That one nearly split my cocoon.
It's biting the silk.
I drop a little.
I swing out and catch again.

lines.zh: 它总算飞走了，丝还留着。
lines.en: It finally flew off. The silk stays.
I hang there, unable to breathe properly.
I hang from a thread under the leaf.
This cocoon was just finished.
The air inside is still warm.
I've started to change.
Outside are the sounds of a village.
Chickens, people, wind.
I'm in this tree. It's safe.
My old body is dissolving.
Something new is growing in here.
In some days I'll come out.

lines.zh: 火烤到叶子，我烫得缩起来。
lines.en: Fire reaches the leaf and I shrink from the heat.
The leaf fell and I hit the ground.

lines.zh: 水渗进丝里，我快闷死了。
lines.en: Water seeps through the silk and I'm suffocating.
A blast tears the leaf apart.

lines.zh: 一支箭擦过茧，丝断了几根。
lines.en: An arrow grazes the cocoon and snaps threads.

lines.zh: 一股力把我定住，连变都停了。
lines.en: A force pins me and even the change stops.
There's nothing left inside me.

lines.zh: 雷打在树上，整根枝都在抖。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the tree and the whole branch shakes.
The thread broke. I keep falling.
